name: MuTual: Multi-Turn Dialogue Reasoning Benchmark
description: MuTual is a reasoning-oriented dataset for multi-turn dialogue comprehension based on Chinese high school English listening comprehension tests. It contains 8,860 multi-turn dialog context-response pairs designed to test conversational reasoning including intent, attitude, and counterfactual logic.

verification.notes: Verified against ACL 2020 paper (DOI: 10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.130) and official GitHub repository (Nealcly/MuTual). Contains 8,860 context-response pairs (train: 7,088, dev: 886, test: 886). Note: repository test directory contains 887 total files including 1 hidden .DS_Store file, giving exactly 886 text instances.
